stages.description: Compare implementation, specification, documentation, security note, ledger, fixture, and packed receipt.
Apply only truthfulness, completeness, or traceability deltas exposed by inspection.
Verify the built runtime ledger, recursively check receipt statuses, and prove fixture bytes and hashes.
Persist the QA report, manifest, reflection, log, state, and convergence decision.

tool_invocations.purpose: Run the scoped built core runtime export-ledger verifier.
Parse the packed receipt and prove fixture parity and SHA-256 identity.

validation_plan.validation_method: Require the scoped built core ledger verifier to pass and only the intended two ./devtools runtime exports to be added.
Require all recursive status leaves to equal pass, both fixtures to compare equal, and both SHA-256 values to match the receipt.
Inspect public and evidence content for explicit downstream exclusions.
